sources.finding: Only current releaser can release; each chosen Currency balance is sent entirely to recipient when positive. Native currency accepted. This implementation emits no Jar release event.
Firepit inherits ExchangeReleaser and fixes the resource recipient to0xdead.

Public release first validates nonce, bounds assets length at20, transfers the resource threshold from caller, releases Jar assets and emits Released. No duplicate/zero-length asset ban in this source.
Nonce equality required then incremented unchecked. Source comments claim ordering protection, but this check does not reserve transaction priority or prevent a competing caller landing first.
Released(uint256,address,address[]) indexes nonce and recipient; data is one dynamic Currency/address array. Native asset uses zero address.
